title: Analisis of Facors Involved in Antidepressant Treatment Response of Major Depressive Disorder
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to predict and visualize sertraline treatment response in major depressive disorder with clinical symptoms, demographic and stress state, personality, eight genetic polymorphisms at baseline.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder
* Must be able to swallow tablets

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant
* breastfeeding
